verdict.rationale: Asana documents its own automation features: rules with rule actions, AI Studio no-code automations, and Rules that automatically act on task context (for example, creating PagerDuty incidents). That implies event-triggered workflows for routine team work. Nothing shows how rules are triggered, and nothing documents scheduled or time-based runs. Third-party tools like Zapier and n8n, and webhooks as a developer building block, earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented scheduled/time-based triggers, a documented rule trigger model for recurring events, in-depth rule/AI Studio docs, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can create a workflow that runs on a schedule or recurring event to handle routine team work

citations.quote: Automate tedious work in powerful, bespoke ways with our platform features like rule actions, webhooks, and our API.
Automatically create PagerDuty incidents with context from Asana tasks using Rules.
